protocol_type: Host-mastered, UPIU-based transaction protocol. The host submits Command UPIUs carrying SCSI/UFS CDBs over the UFS Transport Protocol (UTP); the device returns Response, Data In, RTT, Query Response, Task-Management Response, NOP In and Reject UPIUs. Transport is MIPI UniPro over MIPI M-PHY.

upiu_header_format.description: Every UPIU begins with a Basic Header that identifies the transaction. The header carries Transaction Type, Flags, LUN, Task Tag, Command Set Type, Query/Task function, Total EHS (Extra Header Segment) length and Data Segment length fields.

fields.name: Transaction Type
fields.description: Identifies the UPIU (Command / Response / Data In / Data Out / RTT / Task Mgmt Req+Resp / Query Req+Resp / NOP In+Out / Reject).

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: Transaction flags (e.g. read/write direction, overflow/underflow, end-of-data).

fields.name: LUN
fields.description: Target Logical Unit Number (normal LUN or Well-known LUN).

fields.name: Task Tag
fields.description: Identifies the outstanding task for tagged command queueing.

fields.name: Command Set Type
fields.description: SCSI command set or UFS-specific command set.

fields.name: Query/Task Function
fields.description: Function code for Query Request and Task Management Request UPIUs.

fields.name: Total EHS Length
fields.description: Length of the Extra Header Segment.

fields.name: Data Segment Length
fields.description: Length of the UPIU data segment payload.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Command UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Carries a SCSI/UFS CDB (Command Descriptor Block); initiates a read/write/admin command.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Response UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Returns command status (GOOD / CHECK CONDITION) and SCSI sense data.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Data In UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Carries read payload from device to host.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Data Out UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Carries write payload from host to device, gated by RTT.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Ready To Transfer (RTT) UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Flow-control token telling the host how much write data it may send next; outstanding RTTs bounded by bMaxNumOfRTT.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Task Management Request UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: ABORT TASK, ABORT TASK SET, CLEAR TASK SET, LOGICAL UNIT RESET, QUERY TASK.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Query Request UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Read/write Descriptors, Attributes, Flags without the SCSI command path.

upiu_transaction_types.name: Reject UPIU
upiu_transaction_types.description: Rejection of an invalid or unsupported UPIU.

scsi_command_examples.description: Check whether a LUN is ready for commands.
Return device identification / capabilities for a LUN.
Read logical blocks; payload returned via Data In UPIUs.
Write logical blocks; payload sent via Data Out UPIUs gated by RTT.
Enumerate active LUNs (issued to the REPORT LUNS W-LUN).
Return SCSI sense data for the prior command.
Power / spin control at the LUN level.
Flush cached write data to the medium.
Transport for RPMB and security operations.

query_request_objects.description: Read/write structured device descriptors (Device, Configuration, Unit, Geometry, Interconnect, String, Power, Health, etc.).
Read/write scalar device attributes (e.g. bMaxNumOfRTT, bCurrentPowerMode, dCurrentLBASize).
Read/set/clear/toggle boolean device flags (e.g. fDeviceInit, fPermanentWPEn, fWriteBoosterEn).

command_queueing.description: Host tags outstanding commands; the device may reorder/complete them out of order. In legacy UFSHCI a single doorbell register and a Transfer Request List (UTRD ring, one bit per task tag) track outstanding transfer requests.

Multi-Circular Queue: multiple hardware submission and completion queue pairs, each with its own doorbell and head/tail pointers, analogous to NVMe SQ/CQ pairs, improving parallelism and multi-core scaling.

channels.name: REF_CLK
channels.description: Reference clock supplied by the host to the device.

channels.name: M-PHY TX lanes (DOUT)
channels.description: Device transmit differential pairs (up to 2 lanes), HS-Gear 1..5.

channels.name: M-PHY RX lanes (DIN)
channels.description: Device receive differential pairs (up to 2 lanes), HS-Gear 1..5.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no wire-level VALID/READY handshake; reliability is provided by UniPro data-link retransmission and in-order delivery.
Write data flow is gated by Ready-To-Transfer (RTT) UPIUs from the device; the host sends Data Out UPIUs only up to the granted amount.
Read data flows from device to host via Data In UPIUs after the Command UPIU.
Completion is reported by a Response UPIU; under MCQ the controller posts a completion to the Completion Queue and rings the completion doorbell.

frame_format.upiu_layout: Basic Header (Transaction Type + Flags + LUN + Task Tag + Command Set Type + lengths) + optional Extra Header Segment(s) + optional Data Segment.
frame_format.command_upiu: Header + 16-byte (or extended) SCSI/UFS CDB carried in the Command UPIU.
frame_format.data_transport: Read payload in Data In UPIUs; write payload in Data Out UPIUs gated by RTT UPIUs.
frame_format.transport_stack: UPIUs are carried by the UFS Transport Protocol over UniPro segments/packets/frames over M-PHY symbols.
